annual_probability.cite: No week in the 5-year weekly history (research/MSCI/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json analogues, 2021-10-18 to 2026-09-28, largest_falls/largest_rises/event_weeks) matches a BlackRock concentration shock; zero occurrences observed over ~5 years implies a low-frequency tail, taken here as roughly once per 20 years (0.05/yr).

impact.cite: No historical analogue exists for this specific risk; impact is a stated assumption bounded by [montecarlo].max_jump_impact_assumed = 0.30 (CLAUDE.md config), set below the cap given the risk is a partial client-relationship erosion rather than a total loss.
